_notes: 1.4.1: Doğal nefes h02 kurs içeriği ile kamera nefes/meditasyon ölçümü ayrıldı; sınırlar sayfası mevcut nefes dersini yok saymaz.
1.4.0: Hatha rehberli kursu gerçek ders dosyası, öz kayıt ve ekran yoluyla açıldı. Yoga ailesi teachingOnly: kamera ölçümü/puanı yok, diğer stiller yok. Ölçüm bataryasının kanıt kutusu değişmedi.

1.3.0 (L-253): dürüstlük kutusu SESSİZ bir sınıf taşıyordu — 7 metrik `coreLacksMeasureKind` sınıfında (mesafe/yükseklik) ve kutu o sınıftan HİÇ bahsetmiyordu. Kullanıcı test-başına gerekçeleri görüyordu ama ailenin ÖZETİ o boşluğu atlıyordu. Kapı artık her engel SINIFININ kutuda adlandırılmasını zorluyor.

1.2.0 (L-251, J-133): honestyBox.notMeasured satırları da SEVK EDİLMİŞ İDDİADIR. Motor sınırı anan bir satır, o sınır kalktığı gün YALAN olur — ve kimse yalan söylemeye karar vermez, bir göç yapar. `falsifiedIfBridged` o satırı yalanlayacak metrikleri BEYAN eder; kapı metrik köprüye girdiği an kırmızı yanar ve cümlenin yeniden yazılmasını ZORLAR.

1.1.0 (L-230, Ostinato O-040 aktarımı): honestyBox.measured artık DÜZ METİN DEĞİL, KANIT TAŞIYAN nesne — her iddia dayandığı metrikleri `requires` ile beyan eder ve kabuk onu köprüye karşı DOĞRULAR. Ölçüldü: eski üç iddiadan İKİSİ kabukta canlı değildi ('trunk/shank' düzlem-ayrımı yok, 'hold duration' faz-türevi) ve 'frontal plane' HİÇBİR metrik için doğru değildi (köprü uzayı isotropic). Dürüstlük kutusunun kendisi, uygulamanın en az dürüst yüzeyiydi.
Kütüphane bilgi mimarisi — motion-core 30-URUN-BLUEPRINT-STANDARDI §2 'her öğe kendi sayfası' direktifi.

Kapsamın TAMAMI kullanıcıya baştan görünür: açılmamış dalgalar 'coming_soon' durumuyla listelenir, böylece dar-app algısı oluşmaz. Ama SAHTE/boş kurs asla listelenmez — coming_soon sayfası kurs listesi göstermez, ne geleceğini anlatır.
Her aile sayfası bir 'honestyBox' taşır: bu öğede NELER ÖLÇÜLÜR / NELER ÖLÇÜLMEZ. Bu kutu opsiyonel değil.
Navigasyon kuralı: ana sayfadan aktif kursa ≤2 dokunuş, kütüphaneden herhangi bir kursa ≤3.

families.title: Assessment Battery
families.intro: Twelve camera-based movement tests. Each one measures a specific area and tells you what it could and could not see.

measured.claim: Shoulder, hip and knee angles, in the plane the camera faces
Left and right measured separately on those joints — never averaged into one figure, because a stiff left shoulder and a mobile right one are not one number
Trunk lean and shin angle measured against vertical

notMeasured: Rotation of the hip or shoulder (a single camera cannot recover transverse-plane twist)

notMeasured.claim: Forward lean and sideways lean as two separate figures — the measurement engine keeps a single tilt, so the frontal plane is not read apart from the sagittal one
How far your shin leans from upright — the measurement engine reads a limb against the line of your torso, not against upright, so a shin angle measured this way would change when you lean

Distances and heights — how far your fingertips reach, how high a heel or knee lifts, how far the hips drop in a plank. The measurement engine reads angles between body points and does not read distances at all.

notMeasured: Anything clinical: this is not a screen, a diagnosis, or an injury-risk prediction
An exact, validated degree — we show you the number we measured, but our own validation study has not been run, so it is a reading and not a verdict

families.title: Yoga Styles
families.intro: A complete guided Hatha course is available. Other named styles have no classes in this build; yoga postures are not camera-scored.

children.title: Vinyasa

notMeasured: No Hatha posture is graded or certified by the camera in this course
Breath, pain, joint load and safety cannot be judged from the camera
Advanced inversions are not required practice in this course

measured: The joint angle the goal is defined by, re-measured on a fixed cadence
notMeasured: How close you are in weeks or months — progress rate is individual and we do not predict it
Changes smaller than our measurement noise: below that threshold we say 'no change', not 'improved'

families.intro: No camera and no scoring in this family. Nothing is built behind this name in this build.

measured: Nothing. These sessions are guided by audio and timed — the camera stays off.
notMeasured: Breath rate, depth or quality — a phone camera cannot measure breathing and we do not pretend otherwise
Meditation state or relaxation of any kind

Pose models silently swap limb labels on inverted bodies with high confidence (family finding M-019)

whyNotPage.title: What Lissom doesn't do
whyNotPage.intro: Some of this we chose to leave out. Some of it we cannot do. Those are not the same thing, so every line below says which it is.

items.reason: The pose model is validated on adults, and the youngest reference band we hold is a single 'under 40' group — a nine-year-old and a thirty-nine-year-old would be read against the same line. That is not a measurement, it is an average with a child inside it. Content for minors also carries a duty of care we are not set up to meet.
Lissom does not measure breathing or meditation with the camera. The Hatha course includes natural-breath practice without a breathing score; guided meditation sessions are not included.

Lissom is a general wellness app and is not a medical device, so it does not screen, diagnose or predict injury risk. Those claims require clinical validation we have not done and are not seeking. A movement reading, however carefully taken, is not evidence about your health.

Heat lends you range while you are in it, and we cannot tell borrowed range from your own — a reading taken in a hot room would quietly overstate you. Room temperature is also something an app can neither provide nor verify.
Rotation happens in the plane the camera is looking down, so a single lens cannot recover it. We would rather leave the test out of the battery than print a number we cannot stand behind.
